title: Asset context frame
description: One perp's asset context: mark, mid (nullable), oracle/index, day's notional volume and the venue's native funding rate. Hyperliquid supplies activeAssetCtx with hourly funding and no venue timestamp; Binance B4 adds nextFundingTime for its native settlement period. Also the data of the panel socket's `asset-ctx/<instrumentId>` topic (the trade screen's price header). Mirrors src/domain/marketdata/frames.ts (AssetCtxFrame).

instrument.description: The venue's coin name, with the dex prefix on HIP-3.

dayNtlVlm.description: Notional volume over the last 24 hours, in the collateral token.

funding.description: The venue's current funding rate as a signed fraction: positive, longs pay shorts. Hyperliquid's rate is hourly; Binance's is its native settlement-period rate and is not divided into hours.

nextFundingTime.description: Additive (0037 B4): Binance's next funding time, epoch milliseconds, for its native countdown. Absent retains the existing venue behavior.

decimal.description: A plain non-negative decimal string. Never a JSON number.
